topic: Using buy-nothing groups for household needs vs buying everything new (Dorian vs Linnea)

scenes.narration: Neighbors give away thousands in perfectly usable goods free through buy-nothing groups. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym beside a pile of free household items, comic burst banner reads FREE STUFF, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dorian and Linnea both need furniture for their new apartments.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man dorian and woman linnea in gym gear beside empty apartment sketches labeled NEED FURNITURE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each one needs a desk, lamp, dishes, and a bookshelf.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, dorian and linnea holding a shared list on a gym bench stamped DESK LAMP DISHES BOOKSHELF, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dorian orders everything brand new from an online big-box store.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, dorian on a gym mat tapping a phone cart labeled BIG BOX STORE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His four new items ring up four hundred dollars total.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, dorian holding a receipt near a gym locker stamped FOUR HUNDRED DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Linnea joins her neighborhood buy-nothing group online the same week.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, linnea on a gym mat joining a phone app labeled BUY NOTHING GROUP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Neighbors offer a free desk, lamp, and full dish set.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, linnea beside a gym bench holding a desk lamp and dishes tagged FREE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She picks them up just nearby and pays exactly nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, linnea loading free furniture into a car outside the gym, a tag stamped ZERO DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One month later Dorian is still paying off that credit charge.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked dorian on a gym bench holding a credit statement stamped STILL OWES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Linnea furnished her entire apartment for a grand total of zero.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, linnea flexing in a fully furnished room, a wall sign stamped TOTAL COST ZERO, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She donated her spare chair back to the same group.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, linnea handing a chair to a neighbor outside the gym, a tag labeled GIVE BACK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Check buy-nothing groups first before buying anything brand new. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
